name: Census manager global reference
summary: Resolves the RIP-relative global used as the census-manager root.

builds.notes: Unique runtime match; exact module fingerprint recorded.

evidence.notes: The resolved global passed readability validation and produced census entries used for visible names.

unknowns: Compatibility outside the observed DX11 build

name: Game-thread Lua command bridge
summary: A bounded FIFO hands UTF-8 Lua commands to the engine's existing Lua execution path on a game thread.

builds.notes: Repeated entity-spawn commands were consumed during live campaign gameplay.

threading: Commands must be handed off to an engine-owned game thread; direct external invocation is not claimed safe.

evidence.notes: Completion counters advanced only after the engine consumed queue entries, and spawned-shop commands produced visible entities.

unknowns: Lua VM lifetime across menus and loading screens

name: GetLocalPlayerEntityId
summary: Returns an entity identifier for the local player and is accepted by several observed gameplay bindings.
returnType: entity identifier; exact native type unknown
threading: Observed through the game-thread Lua bridge.

evidence.notes: Accepted as the player argument by angle, spawning orientation, immunity, detection, felony, reward, and RuleSmith calls.

unknowns: Exact integer width and invalid sentinel

name: GetReticleHitLocation
summary: Returns a three-element world-space location for the current reticle hit when one is available.
returnType: Lua table containing X, Y, Z; failure behavior varies with game state
threading: Observed through the game-thread Lua bridge during active gameplay.

evidence.notes: Returned coordinates were used to place visible shop entities at the reticle.

name: GetEntityAngle
summary: Returns an observed angular component for an entity and axis/index selector.
threading: Observed through the game-thread Lua bridge.

evidence.notes: Component 2 produced values useful for orienting spawned shops; the full axis convention has not been mapped.

unknowns: Radians versus degrees outside the observed use

name: SpawnEntityFromArchetype
summary: Creates an entity from an archetype GUID at a supplied position and rotation.

builds.notes: Multiple clothing-shop archetypes spawned visibly in campaign gameplay.

returnType: entity handle; exact type and failure sentinel unknown
threading: Observed through the game-thread Lua bridge.

evidence.notes: Visible shop entities appeared at reticle positions; replacement required explicitly removing the prior entity.

name: RemoveEntity
summary: Requests removal of an entity referenced by an observed Lua entity handle.
threading: Observed through the game-thread Lua bridge.

evidence.notes: Removing the previous companion-spawned shop prevented stale shop reuse before spawning a replacement.

name: ExecuteReward_V2
summary: Accepts a player entity, readable ItemDB record name, and feedback flag; queue consumption does not prove ownership was granted.

builds.notes: Commands were consumed but bulk clothing ownership did not become visible.

returnType: unknown; observed control flow may terminate the current command
threading: Observed through the game-thread Lua bridge.

evidence.notes: The game consumed 604 and later 779 submitted records, but no reliable ownership change was observed; handoff acknowledgement is not a reward-result acknowledgement.

name: TriggerRuleSmithRule
summary: Dispatches a numeric RuleSmith rule identifier with a context string and player entity.
threading: Observed only as a queued game-thread call.

evidence.notes: Two candidate rule IDs were exercised for ETO and tech points, but this research pass lacks independent balance readback.

name: Active-player world-position transform
summary: A captured active-player transform exposes three writable float coordinates with a non-linear display-axis mapping.

builds.notes: Coordinate writes and readback were reproduced in campaign gameplay.

evidence.notes: Writes were immediately read back and teleport recovery stored the pre-write position before modifying any component.

name: Active-player owner capture
summary: Captures the active-player owner pointer used to filter the coordinate writer.

evidence.notes: The site uniquely matched in the observed module and the captured pointer allowed the coordinate writer to be filtered to the active player.

name: Active-player coordinate-object capture
summary: Captures the coordinate object only when the writer's owner matches the active-player owner.

evidence.notes: The filtered pointer produced the live player coordinates and survived immediate readback verification.

name: Map-waypoint world-position capture
summary: Captures three waypoint floats from an observed waypoint-processing object.

evidence.notes: A placed map waypoint published non-zero coordinates used by the working teleport-to-waypoint path.

name: Operative biography and recent-event table
summary: NPC data stores one primary biography-event ID and a bounded array of additional event IDs.

evidence.notes: Known IDs resolved to visible biography strings, including city-level BIRTH events; replacements passed immediate readback.

unknowns: Event object semantics beyond catalog labels

name: Operative scalar statistics
summary: NPC data exposes age, income, and a small status enum alongside biography metadata.

evidence.notes: Scalar writes were guarded by roster identity and immediately verified, with rollback on failure.

unknowns: Full status enum names and downstream state-machine consequences

name: Packed operative appearance record
summary: Current and wardrobe-default appearance records are 24-byte big-endian bitfields with a version/type header.

builds.notes: Readback confirmed; complete visual validation remains incomplete.

evidence.notes: Format header and known component fields decoded consistently; edited bytes passed immediate memory readback.

name: Operative perk ID array
summary: NPC data contains a small-vector-style array of 32-bit perk IDs with inline storage for up to two entries.

builds.notes: Reads are useful; allocating expanded storage failed on a non-unique allocator signature in one session.

evidence.notes: Existing IDs were read from inline and external layouts; an attempted growth path exposed unresolved allocator-signature uniqueness.

name: Operative contract and attendance schedule tables
summary: NPC data references a sparse contract table whose contracts contain participant handles and hashed attendance schedules.

builds.notes: Traversal and readback guards exist; gameplay consequences are not comprehensively validated.

evidence.notes: Participant IDs resolve through census data and start/end values decode as seconds converted to hours.

unknowns: Persistence and AI scheduling side effects
